semiconductor_relevance: High — SVCS Process Innovation is a dedicated manufacturer of front-end semiconductor equipment, crucial for the production of semiconductor devices.
summary: SVCS Process Innovation specializes in manufacturing a diverse range of front-end semiconductor equipment, including compact thermal reactors for research and large furnaces for mass production. Their offerings include high-temperature furnaces for silicon carbide wafer annealing and advanced gas and liquid delivery systems.
capabilities: 2,000°C SiC furnace with ALD single-wafer reactor
Gas and liquid delivery systems including gas cabinets and VMBs
Large four-stage horizontal furnaces for mass production

regional_presence.Europe: Based in the heart of Europe, SVCS focuses on serving the semiconductor industry with innovative equipment solutions.
